source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with monumental layered mountains, misty valleys, a central waterfall gorge, scattered pavilions and village compounds, winding watercourses, bridges, willows, pines, rocks, and small scholar figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: towering_right_mountain_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side mountain massif rising behind the valley, including its stacked rounded ridges, dark contour lines, textured ink washes, dense pine clusters on ledges, and the small roofed pavilion tucked into the upper slope.
must_preserve: layered rounded ridge outlines
vertical and diagonal rock texture strokes
soft ochre wash transitions
dark pine-needle clusters along terraces
small pavilion roof geometry embedded in the slope
mist-softened edges where the massif recedes

motifs.name: left_misty_peak_group
motifs.description: Isolate the left and center-left misty mountain group, including the nearer rounded crag, the darker central needle-like peak, and faint background peaks dissolved in atmospheric wash.
must_preserve: pale ink wash gradients suggesting mist
thin contour lines on the nearer crag
darker silhouette of the central steep peak
soft fading edges of background summits
small pine and shrub accents on lower ridges

motifs.name: central_waterfall_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky gorge with the vertical waterfall, enclosing boulders, stream pool, scattered stones, and the narrow bridge at the base.
must_preserve: parallel falling-water linework
dark crevice outlines around the gorge
rounded boulder contours and interior texture strokes
pebbled splash pool with dot accents
small arched bridge and rail posts
pines along the upper cliff rim

motifs.name: upper_right_valley_village
motifs.description: Isolate the compact village and pavilion cluster on the right mid-slope beneath the mountains, with tiled roofs, low walls, enclosing trees, and adjacent pine-covered hillside.
must_preserve: rectangular roof geometry and tiled roof planes
thin wall and courtyard linework
tree trunks and leaf clusters around the buildings
dark pine textures on the neighboring slope
subtle color accents on roof and wall washes

motifs.name: willow_bend_with_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the winding water bend and bank with leaning willows, low grasses, rocks, and a solitary scholar figure walking near the left edge.
must_preserve: long drooping willow branch strokes
curving shoreline contour
tufts of bank grass and reeds
small scholar figure with robe outline
low rocks and exposed earth strokes
open water wash around the bend

motifs.name: lower_pavilion_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right architectural compound with connected halls, slanted roofs, latticed windows, interior figures, pine tree, flowering shrubs, and adjacent garden wall.
must_preserve: precise roof ridgelines and eaves
lattice window patterns
tiny seated or standing interior figures
dark layered pine needles in front of the buildings
garden wall geometry
pale blue-green and reddish color accents on plants and architecture

motifs.name: scholars_under_gnarled_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-lower rocky terrace with gnarled overhanging trees, three small scholar figures gathered beneath the canopy, a stone table-like slab, and surrounding bank grasses.
must_preserve: twisting tree trunks and exposed roots
dense stippled leaf clusters
three tiny robed scholar figures
flat stone slab or table on the terrace
layered rock ledge contour lines
short grass strokes along the water edge

motifs.name: lower_right_rocky_pine_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right steep rocky ravine with tall pines, angular boulders, layered slopes, dark evergreen clusters, and the small figure on a path near the center-left of the motif.
must_preserve: vertical pine trunks and dark needle masses
angular rock outlines and cracks
curving layered slope bands
tiny path figure with staff-like gesture
blue-green mineral accents on select foliage
contrast between dense trees and open rock wash

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
